card.name: Commas inside drug-interaction example lists
card.fires_on: Commas, closing brackets and linking words between drug names in lists of enzyme inhibitors, inducers or substrates, such as CYP2C9 or CYP3A4 examples. It responds at the separator, where another drug name comes next.
